headline: Berm Rages While Mercy and Expanse Quicken
war_summary: Since the morning wires Palantine Berm has quickened further to thirteen changes in two hours and fifty in the day about Vendett, Windburn Landing and the Pippeli Stones, now counting three Warden, four Colonial and none neutral, while Weathered Expanse has sharpened to seven changes in two hours and twenty-five in the day at Spirit Watch, Crow's Nest and Huntsfort, standing at three Warden, four Colonial and two neutral amid day losses above eleven thousand Colonial and thirteen thousand Warden. Linn Mercy has stirred anew with five changes in two hours and twenty-two in the day at Outwich Ranch and Lathair, holding one Warden, nine Colonial and one neutral with day losses above ten thousand Colonial and eighteen thousand Warden. Marban Hollow, centered on Checkpoint Bua, has fallen silent in the last two hours after twenty-eight changes in the day and now stands one Warden, five Colonial and two neutral. Nevish Line eases to one change in two hours and eleven in the day at Grief Mother, now seven Warden to one Colonial, and Mooring County shows no change in six hours after seventeen in the day.
